chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya al-Halabi, from Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani, from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Blessed and Exalted:
And thus We revealed to you a Spirit from Our Command. You did not know what the Book was, nor the faith.

He عليه السلام said: It is a creature from the creatures of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, greater than Jibra'il and Mika'il. It was with the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, informing him and directing him rightly, and it is with the Imams after him.

key_terms.أَمْرِنَا: Our command; indicating divine origin and authority.
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: The Imams who inherit this divine accompaniment after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.
key_terms.الْإِيمَانُ: Faith; mentioned in the verse as something not previously known before revelation.
key_terms.خَلْقٌ: A creature; showing that the spirit is created by Allah.
key_terms.رُوحًا: A spirit from Allah's command, explained here as a distinct created being.
key_terms.يُسَدِّدُهُ: It directs him rightly and grants divine support.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Spirit from Our Command in Qur'an 42:52 according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about a Spirit from Allah's command as referring to a created being of immense rank. According to the narration, it accompanied the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and continues with the Imams after him, conveying knowledge and divine support. The report highlights the special divine assistance granted to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the Imams عليهم السلام.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Al Halby, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany, from Abu Baseer who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High
[42:52] And thus We Revealed to you a Spirit from Our Command. You did not know what the Book was, nor the Eman.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A creature from the creatures of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, more magnificent than Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> and Mikaeel<sup>as</sup>. It was with Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, informing him<sup>saww</sup>, protecting him<sup>saww</sup>, and it is with the Imams<sup>asws</sup> from after him<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya al-Halabi from abu ’al-Sabah al-Kinani from abu Basir who has said the following.
“I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.
“Thus, We have revealed a Spirit to you, (Muhammad), by Our command. Before, you did not even know what a Book or Faith was, . .” [42:52]

The Imam (a.s.) said, “He is a creature of the creatures of Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High greater than Jibril and Mika’il. He was with the Messenger of Allah to give him news and protected him and he is with the Imams after the Messenger of Allah.”
